notes.title: LumineNight Emergency Bug Update Notice
notes.content:
Hello, this is the LumineNight development team.
We have confirmed a critical bug after the latest update that makes it impossible to progress in the game.

The issue occurs in Mary’s Trial – Bookstore Puzzle, where the game cannot be played normally. Specifically, when adjusting the position of the notes with the mouse, the note’s shape changes, causing the puzzle to become impossible to clear.

As a temporary workaround, the puzzle can still be cleared if you use a keyboard or gamepad instead of the mouse.

This bug is scheduled to be fixed within today.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

For other bug reports or inquiries related to the game, please contact us at spickasoft@gmail.com



Thank you.

notes.title: LumineNight 1.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.2.2 Hotfix

 Modified the conversation UI to adjust its size according to the screen resolution.
 Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when investigating again immediately after investigating the hotel notepad.


1.2.1 Hotfix

 Fixed an issue where certain puzzles could not be solved when manipulated with the mouse.


1.2.0 Patch Notes

 Optimized the implementation of the Memo UI.
 Made additional optimizations based on graphics settings.
 Adjusted the gamepad control scheme in certain UI screens.
 Fixed an issue where gamepad icons might not display correctly in certain situations.
 Fixed an issue where untranslated text would appear in some languages.
 Fixed an issue where the game could loop in certain situations.


Demo Version Changes

 The demo version has been updated to reflect the changes in Version 1.2.0 of the full game.


Thank you.

notes.title: LumineNight 1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.1.0g Hotfix

 Fixed an issue where dialogue volume could not be adjusted in certain situations.


1.1.0f Hotfix

 Fixed an issue where dialogues were displayed incorrectly at certain resolution ratios.
 Adjusted the main screen and chapter selection screen to adapt based on the resolution.
 Fixed a typo in the date text when entering a specific map.


1.1.0e Hotfix

 Rearranged objects and hitboxes in a specific late-game map to make investigation targets clearer.
 Fixed an issue where keyboard controls would malfunction after manipulating certain UI elements in the settings with the mouse.


1.1.0d Hotfix

 Fixed an issue where progression became impossible in the hotel lobby map.
 Unified the control guide to show keyboard controls when using keyboard and mouse.


1.1.0c Hotfix

 Some credit information has been changed.


1.1.0b Hotfix

 Fixed an issue where Korean and English were incorrectly linked in the language settings during the first launch.


1.1.0a Hotfix

 Fixed an issue where the close button disappeared on the chapter selection screen.
 Fixed an issue where the beach map background texture was broken.


1.1.0 Patch Notes

Language Support
The following language data has been added:

 Japanese
 Simplified Chinese
 Traditional Chinese
 Russian
 Spanish

Some UI text sizes have been adjusted.
The English font has been changed.

Gamepad Support

 When using a gamepad, control guide icons will now match the corresponding controller.
 Added support for DualSense and DualShock 4.
 Steam Input is now supported.


Game Resources

[strike] Unused margins in game data files have been removed.
 The installation size has been reduced to within 4GB; however, update downloads will now be significantly larger.[/strike]
 Background and UI textures have been optimized for FHD resolution.
 Additional SFX has been added.

Game Save Data

 The save file location has changed:

 Previous: %localappdata%\Case101
 New: %localappdata%\LumineNight
 Upon launching the game for the first time after the update, existing save files will be moved to the new directory.
 Steam Cloud Save is now supported.


Bug Fixes and Miscellaneous Changes

Demo Version Changes

 The demo version has been updated to reflect the changes in Version 1.1.0 of the full game.
 Map Exploration and Stealth Mode have been removed.
 Players who wish to play the previous version of the demo can do so by switching branches in the [Settings] menu.
 Save data can now be carried over to the full game. If you purchase the full version after completing the demo, you can continue playing from where you left off.


Due to the scale of this update, there may be unexpected bugs, particularly regarding language support and translations.
If you encounter any issues, please report them on the Steam Community forums. Your feedback will help us improve the game and provide better service.
Thank you.

notes.title: The 1.09 patch for LumineNight
notes.content:
The 1.09 patch for LumineNight is uploaded.

Patch Notes for Version 1.09:

- Improved memo UI functionality
- Modified UI shortcut bindings and added guide
- Fixed an issue where auto-save wasn't working at certain levels
- Modified some resources
- Fixed bugs in some puzzles

notes.title: The 1.08 patch for LumineNight
notes.content:
The 1.08 patch for LumineNight is uploaded.

Patch Notes for Version 1.08:

- Added auto-save checkpoints and updated the recent progress loading feature.
- Introduced a skip option for the police station sneak stage. This option becomes available after being caught by Coleman five or more times.
- Fixed freezing issues.
- Enhanced puzzle convenience and fixed bugs.
- Corrected text and image errors.


Planned Future Updates:

- Updates and bug fixes for the memo function UI.
- Binding of missing shortcut keys.

notes.title: The 1.07 patch for LumineNight
notes.content:
The 1.07 patch for LumineNight is uploaded.

Patch Notes for Version 1.07:
Added cancel/close functionality to the Esc key. The Esc key will no longer open the menu. The key to open the menu has been changed to P.
Reduced the difficulty of infiltrating the hotel lobby.
Fixed a bug where white dots appeared on Selen's UI during the police station infiltration.
Added English character names to the notebook.
Fixed a text bug in the Beach Death Case file.
Fixed a bug where the character dialogue volume option was not applying properly.
Fixed a bug in the Korean version where some resources appeared in English.
Fixed a bug in the Korean version where some resource pages were duplicated.
Fixed a bug in the English version where some deduction combinations displayed Korean text.

Upcoming 1.08 Patch (within this week):
Addition of more than 30 auto-save points.

Planned Future Updates:
Skip feature for the police station infiltration sequence.
Updates and bug fixes for the memo function UI.
Binding of missing shortcut keys.

notes.title: Notice about known issues in LumineNight
notes.content:
Hello,

As of December 3, 2024, we would like to provide an update regarding known bugs in the game Luminanite.

The currently identified bugs are as follows:

- Keyboard input not functioning properly in certain UI elements.
[strike]- White objects appearing outside the mansion.[/strike](solved)
- UI character resources breaking in low-spec mode.
[strike]- Dialogue log content becoming corrupted during infiltration.[/strike](solved)
- Some texts not localized into english, showing korean.
- Getting stuck while reading diary.
- Getting stuck after using contemplate

We are actively working to resolve these issues as quickly as possible.
And is currently adding on more autosave checkpoint which will be ready within first week of December.
We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

Thank you.
